title: Letter and Verdict
author: Orsen Okafor
blurb: Ines Thackeray, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has spent fifteen years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the tide gives up what it took.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
